shots.action: stand on a hummock at the corruption ring edge, mist drifting
face the creeping grey edge; the corruption advances a handspan
hand cocks a crossbow; a frost-arrow crystallises in the groove
hair rolls in a slow weightless wave; neon teal brightens; spores near her freeze and fall
gauntlet grips the greatsword hilt; rune-tattoo ember-gold wakes along the wrist
rises from the corrupted patch; spore-sacs inflate; maw opens
a thorned tendril coils tight, then snaps
raises an arm; a rotating frost-and-sigil ring blooms; drifting spores crystallize and fall
tendril whip gouges a blight-furrow across the marsh
kicks off in a comet of rime over the water
fires both crossbows; three crystalline frost-bolts streak
bolts strike a tendril; flash-freeze spreads; the vine goes brittle white
plants the greatsword tip; a gold shockwave cracks the corrupted floor
swings a radiant two-handed arc; it detonates on the bloom
reels; maw twists; spore-sacs flare brighter
the bloom sweeps a tendril across the arena; both heroes vault opposite ways
flips back and lands in a crouch, frost-smoke curling
eyes ignite; twin white-blue lances slash out
COMBO Freeze-and-Sunder: her Rime Beams freeze a tendril mid-swing; his Verdict shatters it in a golden shockwave through ice
staggers; the frozen vine fractures; the maw opens in a silent roar
hunches; spore-sacs rupture one after another
raises the sword; a light-blade summons above
the light-blade plunges; the bloom staggers under a white pillar
slams root-feet; spore rain begins; the sky dims green
curls under her wings in a Glacial Aura; spores hiss to snow on the membrane
strides through the spore rain; light sheds it like water; the ground flushes teal at his boots
exhales a choking green spore gout in a rising column
she vaults the gout while he charges through its shadow
stands square; a white-gold cone scours the ground; blight recedes in a wave
winds up; wings fold; snow coils concentrate around her
dives lance-first, crossbows leading, a frozen trail behind
impact crater; spore-sacs flicker; the bloom is forced to one root-knee
COMBO Hoarfrost Judgement: he marks the sac-cluster with a rune; her frost locks it; the rune detonates in a light column through ice
regrips the sword; holy runes blaze up the blade
enrages; swells open; spores spiral into a vortex
the maw opens full; a spore-voice speaks (subtitle D4)
ignites the Pollen Nova; a spore supernova rises, drowning the marsh light
wing-flare, crossbows raised; glacier energy peaks
plants his hands; the tattoo surges gold-to-white; golden wings bloom
still-beat: the two hold under the rising spore-nova
leaps in full Glacier Form; Immortal wings wide; snowstorm against the spores
rises radiant; greatsword burning white-gold
COMBO Blizzard & Verdict: both launch together; a frost streak and a gold streak winding around each other
fires Rime Beams and both crossbows at once; a violet-white lance punches through the bloom heart
the final Verdict arc splits the bloom; light floods out
the Pollen Nova collapses inward; light versus spore
the corpse-flower head cracks, folds shut, wilts
spores settle like grey snow; two silhouettes over the purifying patch
exhales a wisp of frost; hair dims to the idle gradient; she almost smiles
turns, greatsword over his shoulder; dawn breaks; the marsh water glows teal again

dialogue.D1: „Дојдовте да расцветате во мене, како сите што дојдоа пред вас.“
dialogue.D4: „Од трева сте — и во трева ќе ве вратам!“
dialogue.D7: „И во најтоплото мочуриште, зимата наоѓа пат.“
